meta.title: AdxLens
meta.description: Evidence-backed Meta Ads reports for agencies

common.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errors.notFoundBody: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.
errors.forbiddenTitle: You don't have access to this page
errors.forbiddenBody: Ask your workspace owner to grant you access.
errors.genericBody: We have logged the error. If it keeps happening, send the error code below to support.
errors.featureUnavailableTitle: This feature is not enabled for this workspace
errors.featureUnavailableBody: Contact the AdxLens team if you would like to try it.

landing.title: Meta Ads reports with evidence, matching Ads Manager
landing.subtitle: Send clients agency-branded reports with numbers within 1% of Ads Manager, ready 10 minutes after you connect.
landing.assurance: Read-only data · No card required · Connect in minutes

match.title: Numbers that match
match.body: Every report carries a reconciliation line against Ads Manager. If the gap is over 1%, we block sending and tell you.

brand.title: Your agency's brand
brand.body: Your logo, colors and email. Clients open a link, no sign-up needed.

evidence.title: Findings with evidence
evidence.body: Every finding links to the source numbers so you can check them yourself. No numbers made up by AI.

steps.send: Check reconciliation and send the report

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.basis: Priced per active ad account (spend in the last 30 days), never as a % of ad spend. Extra account: {extra}/month. Pay yearly and save {discount}%. Prices exclude VAT.
pricing.breakEvenLink: Break-even page: hours saved per account × your hourly rate vs. the monthly fee. See the formula

free.name: Free
free.summary: Reports, public links, PDF. Includes a "Powered by AdxLens" label.

starter.name: Starter
starter.summary: Adds weekly recommendations, creative library, detailed reconciliation.

growth.name: Growth
growth.summary: Adds approved actions and automation rules (early access).

scale.name: Scale
scale.summary: Adds full white-label: remove the "Powered by" label, priority support.

read.title: Data we read
read.body: Campaign, ad set and ad metrics, spend and results from the ad accounts you authorize. We never write or change anything on Meta.

store.title: How we store it
store.body: Access tokens are encrypted and used only to sync metrics. We never store your Meta password.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Disconnect at any time and ask us to delete your data. See the <link>data deletion guide</link>.

service.title: 1. The service
service.body: AdxLens provides reports and analysis from the Meta Ads data you give it read access to.

responsibility.title: 2. Responsibility to your clients
responsibility.body: You are responsible for the reports you send to your clients. Reports whose numbers differ from Ads Manager by more than 1% cannot be shared.

billing.title: 3. Billing and grace period
billing.body: Fees are per active account. If a payment fails, data keeps syncing during the grace period.

deletion.title: Data deletion guide
deletion.intro: There are two ways to ask us to delete the data AdxLens stored from your Meta account.

inApp.title: Option 1: In AdxLens
inApp.body: Connections › choose the connection › "Disconnect and delete data". We email you a confirmation once deletion is complete.

fromFacebook.title: Option 2: From Facebook
fromFacebook.body: Settings › Apps and websites › AdxLens › Remove. Meta forwards the request to us and we delete the data within 30 days.

track.title: Track a request
track.body: Enter your confirmation code to see the deletion status.
track.notFound: No request found for this code. Check the code in your confirmation email.

status.pending: Request received, waiting to be processed.

signup.title: Create your agency account
signup.description: Free to try. Read-only access to Meta; we never write to your ad accounts.
signup.acceptTerms: I agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>

verify.description: We sent a verification link to {email}. The link is valid for 24 hours.

forgot.description: Enter your sign-up email and we will send you a reset link.
forgot.sent: If this email has an account, we sent a password reset link. The link is valid for 60 minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.note: The link expires after 60 minutes. Once reset, all other sessions are signed out.
reset.expiredBody: Links are valid for 60 minutes. Request a new one to get another link.

onboarding.description: A workspace holds your agency's clients, ad accounts and members.

onboarding.note: Each ad account keeps its own time zone and currency from Meta.
onboarding.invalid: Some details are invalid. Check the name, time zone and currency.

settingsMembers.approveNote: Only the owner can let media buyers approve actions, per client. Off by default.

connect.s03Title: AdxLens only reads your ad data
connect.s03Intro: Next, Meta will ask you to grant read access. Here's what we do and don't do.

read.title: Read metrics
read.body: Campaigns, ad sets, ads, spend, results, budgets.

write.title: Change anything on Meta
write.body: We never pause ads, change budgets, or create or delete ads.

control.title: You stay in control
control.body: Disconnect at any time and ask us to delete your data (Connections).

connect.s04Limit: The {plan} plan tracks up to {limit} accounts. You can change this later.
connect.s04Over: You selected more than the {limit} accounts in the {plan} plan. Accounts over the limit keep syncing during the grace period; upgrade to keep them.
connect.s04EmptyBody: This Meta account has no ad accounts you can view. Check your permissions in Business Manager and reconnect.

clients.s05Intro: AdxLens suggests a Client from the account name. Confirm each row so a Client's report only includes their own accounts.

clients.s05Empty: There are no ad accounts to assign yet.

clients.emptyBody: Add your first Client and assign ad accounts to start building reports.
clients.footnote: Spend, health and reconciliation appear after the first sync. Figures use each account's currency and time zone.
clients.c02NoData: Campaign figures appear once syncing finishes.
